label: vehicles
name: Vehicles Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR vehicle image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible vehicle type, structure, and transportation mode.

labels.car: A photo primarily showing a car, sedan, hatchback, SUV, coupe, or similar passenger automobile.
labels.motorcycle: A photo primarily showing a motorcycle, motorbike, or scooter.
labels.bicycle: A photo primarily showing a bicycle, cycle, mountain bike, road bike, or similar pedal-powered vehicle.
labels.van: A photo primarily showing a van, minivan, delivery van, cargo van, or passenger van.
labels.truck: A photo primarily showing a truck, lorry, pickup truck, cargo truck, or other heavy road vehicle.
labels.bus: A photo primarily showing a bus, coach, minibus, school bus, or public transport bus.
labels.construction_vehicle: A photo primarily showing construction machinery such as an excavator, bulldozer, crane, loader, road roller, or dump truck.
labels.train: A photo primarily showing a train, locomotive, railway carriage, metro train, tram, or other rail vehicle.
labels.aircraft: A photo primarily showing an airplane, jet, helicopter, glider, or other aircraft.
labels.boat: A photo primarily showing a boat, ship, yacht, ferry, canoe, or other watercraft.
